name: capabilities
description: Conditional substructural capabilities with distinct destruction, deep cloning and immutable native sharing.

cases.reason: The intended conditional capabilities resolve.
Conditional K/W-like combinators and shared aliases execute through native Rust.
Owned has no Clone capability.
Owned requires explicit finish; Rust destructor presence does not grant the PS Drop policy.
Drop does not imply Clone.
Independent Clone plus Drop does not imply Shared.
Conditional pair Drop cannot hide an Owned component.
W-like routing still requires Clone Owned.
The first consumption produces Int, not Owned.
An unrestricted lambda is not a trusted Sub arrow.
The Sub constructor is private.
The unchecked instruction builder is private to the trusted module.
The execution boundary cannot return an opaque resource.
The input role is nominal even for a visible representationally equal wrapper.
The output role is nominal even for a visible representationally equal wrapper.
Visible newtype coercion itself is valid; the Sub roles cause the rejections.
Explicit unsafeCoerce bypasses the discipline; compile-only control, never executed.
A separate trusted FFI module adds a new non-Clone Rust owner, operations and Drop instance through the extension protocol.
An externally introduced Drop resource does not acquire Clone implicitly.
The extension resource has no Shared capability.
The external consumption operation also changes the arrow output type.
